title: DES: the public standard (FIPS PUB 46, 1977)
description:
The Data Encryption Standard — published as FIPS PUB 46 in 1977, with its full specification and S-boxes public — was America's first open encryption standard. Published before export controls tightened, it became the world's most-studied cipher.

DES is the archetypal grandfathered file: a complete public standard, forever public.

Code as speech, encryption as right: the investigation's collapse was the turning point.
